patches.title: Highest Countertop First
patches.principle: Start searching open surfaces at the highest-numbered countertop and go downward.
patches.when_to_apply: When beginning exploration for an object on countertops.

patches.title: Verify Object Name Matches
patches.principle: Only pick up and place objects whose exact name matches the task description.
patches.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the goal.

patches.title: Skip Closed Containers After Open
patches.principle: If a container is closed and you already opened it earlier, do not open it again.
patches.when_to_apply: When revisiting a container you previously opened.
